Community models and agents — 2026-10-21

## 🧩 Models

### 🆕 New
- 🧠 `community/sharktide/inferenceport-ai-gpt-6-luna` — image input, tools and reasoning · 0.075 / 0.375 pollen per 1M tokens · paid-only
- 🧠 `community/CloudCompile/qwen-qwen3.5-122b-a10b` — text input and output · 0.01 / 0.05 pollen per 1M tokens
- 🧠 `community/Saauf/minimax-m3.1-flash` — image input, tools and reasoning · output 0.01 pollen per 1M tokens; input price not listed
- 🧠 `community/JustScriptzz/claude-sonnet-5.5` — image input, tools and reasoning · 1.00 / 5.00 pollen per 1M tokens
- 🧠 `community/Saauf/nemotron-3.5-super-vl` — image and video input, tools and reasoning · 0.20 / 0.40 pollen per 1M tokens
- 🧠 `community/sonofstrange/qwen3.8-flash` — image input and tools · 0.04 / 0.12 pollen per 1M tokens · paid-only
- 🎨 `community/CloudCompile/z-image-turbo` — text-to-image · price not listed
- 🎨 `community/Saauf/seedream-5.0-lite` — text-to-image · 0.20 pollen per image · paid-only
- 🎨 `community/Saauf/grok-imagine-image` — text-to-image · 0.25 pollen per image · paid-only
- 🎨 `community/JustScriptzz/qwen-image-2.1-turbo` — text-to-image · 0.05 pollen per image
- More new models are in the diff; the full set does not fit in one Discord message.

### 🔒 Access
- `community/sharktide/inferenceport-ai-gemini-2.5-flash` — now paid-only
- `community/sharktide/inferenceport-ai-qwen-3.8-27b` — now paid-only

## 🤖 Agents

### 🆕 New
- `community/danhquach/prompt-enhancer` — agent on `openai/gpt-5.4-nano` · image input, tools and reasoning
- `community/danhquach/bug-report-writer` — agent on `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash` · image input, tools and reasoning

### 🔁 New base model
- `community/samueltargino0567-ux/Gt3` — now agent without a base model (was `community/JustScriptzz/qwen-3.8-max`)

Explore at https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs
